b1-unit-47.47.1 Gap Year Diaries: what's on your pl:
Danny: Welcome back to Gap Year Diaries! Today's topic is music, and my roommate Bruno is here with me. Hi Bruno!
Bruno: Hi everyone!
Danny: So, Bruno and I share a room, and both of us listen to music all day. But our tastes are very different. What's on your playlist?
Bruno: Mostly rock and metal. Heavy, energetic music for running. And some old samba that my grandfather used to play.
Danny: I prefer calm music. I listen to both jazz and classical when I'm working. And some country, because of my mom. She always plays country in the car.
Bruno: At least neither of us likes the music at the gym!
Danny: True! Do you play an instrument?
Bruno: I played the drums in a band at school. We wanted to record an album, but we never got a record deal. We performed live only once... at my cousin's wedding.
Danny: I can play neither the piano nor the guitar. I tried the trumpet when I was a kid, but our neighbors complained.
Bruno: Ha! And how do you listen to music?
Danny: Either on my phone or on my laptop. But my dream is a record player.
Bruno: My dad has an old record player and hundreds of records. Maybe one day he'll give them to me.
Danny: And now some news. Our friend Rafa plays the saxophone in a jazz band, and they're performing live at a bar near the hostel next Friday.
Bruno: Both of us are going, of course. Neither of us would miss it!
Danny: So, listeners: do you prefer calm music or energetic music? Send me your playlist!
